name: lazy-bones
description: The best code is the code never written. /lazy-bones:yagni switches the session into lazy senior dev mode: a YAGNI decision ladder (skip it → reuse it → stdlib → native → installed dep → one line → minimum code) enforced on every coding task, with lite/full/ultra intensity levels — never lazy about validation, error handling, security, or accessibility. /lazy-bones:review reviews a diff (staged, unstaged, whole branch, or a GitHub PR via --pr <number>) for over-engineering only — one tagged line per finding and a net-lines-cut score. /lazy-bones:audit scans the repo (or a path) for over-engineering and returns a ranked report of what to delete, simplify, or replace with stdlib/native equivalents. Adapted from DietrichGebert/ponytail (MIT).
